rationale: A best satisfies the tri-fold brief with a clear six-panel system, strong retreat-specific hierarchy, cohesive coastal/fitness/wellness imagery, readable calls to action, and credible print production. E is also visibly tri-fold and thematically complete, but its hierarchy and typography are less refined. C communicates the offer clearly with polished imagery and useful package details, though the shown format does not convincingly read as a tri-fold. B has a bold, distinctive fitness-oriented cover but reveals too little of the brochure and leans more toward an editorial fitness flyer than a balanced wellness retreat. D is clean but sparse and is explicitly presented as a bifold, making it the weakest fit for the stated format.
uncertainty_notes: The low-resolution composites prevent reliable assessment of body-copy legibility, exact fold alignment, bleeds, and print readiness. Several options are cropped or show only partial/mockup views, especially B, D, and E, and the brief excerpt omits potentially decisive content and brand requirements.
